summary: Geopolitical alerts that can move oil. Scans every 10 minutes in the morning, every 5 minutes from noon to 10:00 pm, every 10 minutes late evening and every hour overnight (2:00 am to 8:00 am Singapore time) on weekdays, and every 3 hours from Saturday 3:00 am to Monday 3:00 am Singapore time. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

alerts.eventTime: Morning, 11 Nov (est.; likely the incident UKMTO flagged ~11:07 am)
alerts.headline: Iranian state media: Iran's army says another oil tanker caught fire this morning east of the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine; IRGC says two other tankers were intercepted; vessel not named
alerts.source: First Squawk and LiveSquawk, citing Iranian state media (IRIB, Tasnim)

alerts.headline: Satellite thermal imagery reportedly shows a second ship burning in the Strait of Hormuz after this morning's tanker incident; OSINT accounts suspect an IRGC attack or mine, vessel and cause unconfirmed
alerts.source: Post Open Source (CocoPostel), via AB4_Ali3; also AMK Mapping, WW3 Monitor

alerts.headline: UKMTO (warning 202-26) reports a new incident involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz; crew status, damage and environmental impact unknown, vessels told to transit with caution
alerts.source: UKMTO Operations Centre; also FinancialJuice, First Squawk

alerts.headline: Leningrad governor confirms drones struck Russia's Ust-Luga Baltic oil export port, with initial data pointing to a fire in the port area; damage to loadings not yet stated
alerts.source: FinancialJuice, citing Leningrad region governor

alerts.headline: US ambassador to China David Perdue says Trump offered to swap China's Iranian oil imports for US oil
alerts.source: zerohedge headline citing Perdue

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Ust-Luga Baltic oil export port: footage shows port infrastructure on fire and multiple explosions; Leningrad governor reports dozens of drones downed, no official damage statement yet
alerts.source: Maks_NAFO_FELLA / NotWoofers / markito0171 footage

alerts.headline: Ukraine launches a massive drone raid on Leningrad region; Russian monitors say Ust-Luga oil export terminal is the main target, St Petersburg port also targeted and Pulkovo airport restricted; no confirmed hit yet
alerts.source: OSINTtechnical / NOELreports

alerts.headline: Fire breaks out on the SPD14D platform in Iran's South Pars gas field, forcing a full evacuation; Fars says about 14.5 mcm/d of gas is affected and the cause (gas leak or operational fault) is under investigation
alerts.source: Fars News via First Squawk

alerts.headline: Qatar's PM reportedly told G7 foreign ministers in Paris that Doha has secured 'at least two weeks' for diplomacy toward a US-Iran understanding (Jerusalem Post).
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing the Jerusalem Post

alerts.headline: Iran's IRGC says an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz, state broadcaster IRIB reports; vessel name not given
alerts.source: Walter Bloomberg (citing IRIB); also CGTN America

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: several accounts report an explosion in the Strait of Hormuz, and one cites a local source on a missile launch from southern Iran toward the strait and two blasts; no official or wire confirmation yet
alerts.source: UK Report; also Interceptor News, Gulfion

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (UKMTO warning issued ~9:38 pm SGT, 10 Nov)
alerts.headline: UKMTO says a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile about 19 nm northeast of Lima, Oman, near the Strait of Hormuz approach; crew safe, master to assess damage at first light
alerts.source: UKMTO via First Squawk; also Open Source Intel, Middle East Brief

alerts.eventTime: Not stated (talks in Abu Dhabi, 10 Nov)
alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: US negotiators at the Abu Dhabi Ukraine talks reportedly floated letting Russian oil and gas back into the European market as part of a ceasefire deal, The Economist reports
alerts.source: War Monitor citing The Economist; also Chamberlain's Ghost

alerts.eventTime: Tue afternoon UAE time, ~7 pm SGT (est.)
alerts.headline: ADNOC Logistics & Services says one of its vessels was damaged in an attack in UAE territorial waters in the Gulf; response under way
alerts.source: ADNOC L&S statement via UAE state agency WAM; also World Conflict, Middle East Brief

alerts.headline: Houthis claim four strikes on Saudi Arabia: Aramco's Abqaiq facility, East-West pipeline pumping stations, Riyadh airport and financial district; no Saudi confirmation yet (translated from Arabic)
alerts.source: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree (Arabic); also Al Mayadeen, CGTN, FinancialJuice

alerts.headline: Rubio: Iran's deal conditions are 'absurd', sides 'not even close'; no reparations
alerts.source: Open Source Intel (X), relaying Rubio remarks

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Iran has agreed to US demands to cut its highly enriched uranium levels, according to Al Hadath sources, a step toward a deal that would reopen Hormuz
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing Al Hadath sources

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Russia's Kirishi (KINEF) refinery reportedly fully shut after the 9 Nov Ukrainian drone attack, with three main crude units (AVT-2, AT-1, AT-6) said to be damaged, per a Russian Telegram channel
alerts.source: Special Kherson Cat, citing Russian Telegram channel Dosye Shpiona

alerts.headline: IRGC Navy says two 'violating' tankers using an unauthorised route through the Strait of Hormuz hit explosives and caught fire, per Iranian state media (Tasnim, IRIB); no UKMTO confirmation yet
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing Tasnim; also LiveSquawk, citing IRIB

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: ADNOC cuts December Murban official selling price to about $4/bbl above Dubai from $11.10 a month earlier (a $7 cut), with Das, Upper Zakum and Umm Lulu also lowered, days after Aramco's December cuts for Asia
alerts.source: Anushree Mukherjee; also The Officials

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: Rostov-on-Don, Taganrog and Azov ports in Russia's Rostov region reportedly brought to a near standstill by Ukrainian strikes; Rostov governor warns of industry collapse. The Azov ports ship Russian oil products
alerts.source: NSTRIKE

alerts.headline: Bloomberg: Saudi Arabia's main shipping firm Bahri is sending some tankers through the Strait of Hormuz in coordination with the US military
alerts.source: Bloomberg

alerts.headline: Russia's Defence Ministry says its forces struck a cargo ship and a tanker in the Black Sea; vessels and location not named
alerts.source: First Squawk (Russian Defence Ministry)

alerts.headline: Houthis urge foreign companies operating in Saudi Arabia to disclose their identities and investment locations so their facilities can be spared possible bombardment (Xinhua, translated from French)
alerts.source: Xinhua (French service)

alerts.headline: UKMTO notes reduced Strait of Hormuz transits, with most vessels using the northern route; this follows Iran's reported strike on Didamar Island navigation aids in the southern corridor
alerts.source: Gulf News (UKMTO)

alerts.headline: Bloomberg: refined-product loadings in the Persian Gulf rose to about 3 million b/d in October from a 1 million b/d May trough, mostly exiting Hormuz and easing a tight market
alerts.source: Bloomberg

alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted a drone over Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region, the Aramco oil heartland, widening Houthi attacks beyond Riyadh and the south
alerts.source: First Squawk (coalition statement), also RedboxGlobal

alerts.headline: Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh: sirens and Saudi Civil Defense hazard warnings, two explosions heard in north Riyadh as air defences intercepted. No energy damage reported yet
alerts.source: FirstSquawk (Saudi Civil Defense), AMK Mapping, The Cradle

alerts.headline: Houthi launches reported from Yemen toward Khamis Mushait and Abha in southern Saudi Arabia; Saudi early-warning platform issued an alert for Khamis Mushait. No impact or energy damage reported yet
alerts.source: MenchOsint, relayed by Post Open Source

alerts.headline: Trump after Qatar PM talks: Gulf states prefer the status quo, so the Iran naval blockade and Operation Iron Gate continue; strikes 'locked and loaded' but unlikely
alerts.source: Trump on Truth Social via FirstSquawk

alerts.headline: FT: Arab and Muslim leaders are pushing to stop Trump from reigniting the Iran war, after Trump told Reuters the US is 'ready to go anytime'
alerts.source: Financial Times via LiveSquawk

alerts.headline: Al Arabiya sources: a preliminary US-Iran deal on cutting uranium enrichment is likely; the reported framework would reopen Hormuz and lift the naval blockade immediately, return IAEA inspectors and free $6-9 billion of Iranian assets. Brent settled down 5.85% at $92.57 on the reports
alerts.source: First Squawk and Open Source Intel, citing Al Arabiya

alerts.headline: Reuters survey: OPEC oil output rose in October to about 90% of its pre-war rate, led by gains in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Iraq, though exports are still held back by the Iran war and the US blockade on Iranian shipments
alerts.source: Post Open Source, citing a Reuters survey

alerts.headline: Iran reportedly struck Oman's Didamar Island in southern Hormuz, with footage showing smoke over radar and communications gear; the IRGC claims it disabled the navigation system used by US Navy-assisted ships and threatens to shut all shipping on the southern corridor (may be the same strike as the navigation aids reported at 12:16 pm)
alerts.source: Open Source Intel, citing IRGC claims and footage

alerts.headline: Zero Hedge: a cold blast puts the US Mid-Atlantic and Northeast on watch for the season's first snowstorm, a boost to heating-oil and gas demand in the main US heating-oil region
alerts.source: Zero Hedge

alerts.headline: Saudi Press Agency: Saudi Arabia's East-West crude pipeline, the main route for bypassing Hormuz, was targeted in the Medina region on 9 Nov; a limited fire was put out with no injuries and no impact on operations
alerts.source: LiveSquawk, citing the Saudi Press Agency (official)

alerts.headline: Iran's Tasnim denies reports that security chief Mohsen Rezaei met US VP Vance in Doha; a senior Tehran official says no talks are planned until the US acts on Iran's seven conditions
alerts.source: Open Source Intel, citing Tasnim News and Iranian state media

alerts.headline: Turkish intelligence chief Kalın says Qatar will host US VP JD Vance and Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei in Doha next week to try to break the stalled US-Iran talks; Tehran has not confirmed
alerts.source: Tzvi Joffre, citing Turkish intelligence chief İbrahim Kalın (also reported by Mehr)

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: UAE's Khor Fakkan closes Al Luluyah beach after an oil spill is spotted along the coast near the Gulf of Oman port; source of the spill not stated
alerts.source: First Squawk citing a local notice; also Giovanni Staunovo

alerts.headline: UKMTO reclassifies a 7 Nov incident near Khasab, Oman, as an attack: a tanker caught fire and its crew was evacuated (late report)
alerts.source: UKMTO via FinancialJuice and CGTN Europe

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: Ukrainian drones set Russia's Ust-Luga Baltic oil export port ablaze, confirmed by Leningrad's governor, while UKMTO reported a new tanker incident in Hormuz.
Iran's army says another tanker hit a mine and caught fire east of Hormuz, after a South Pars platform fire and Trump's reported US oil offer to China.
